Lessons.Title: Flexible with Fractions (optional)
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will interpret and solve problems that involve adding, subtracting, and multiplying fractions.
Key idea: Optional mixed-fraction modelling problems require preserving physical lengths and using fraction arithmetic to test designs.
How to reason: Translate each sticky-note length or trail measurement into common units, then compare total to the physical limit.

First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 3: Find a Match (25 minutes): apply the learning goal to the original contexts or representations. First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
